create_EdgeBlock: create an EdgeBlock that updates edge features using sender nodes, receiver nodes, and globals
create_NodeBlock: create a NodeBlock that updates node features using received edges, sent edges, and globals
create_GlobalBlock: create a GlobalBlock that updates global features using aggregated edges, nodes, and globals
build_NodesToGlobalsAggregator: build a NodesToGlobalsAggregator that reduces per-node features to per-graph globals using a reducer
build_broadcast_globals_to_edges: broadcast global features to all edges in a graph based on edge-to-graph membership
